$comment: Verification V2 is gated only by exact persisted WaveUnit/CandidateAttempt truth. Legacy operations retain their persisted completion contract until Task 12 cutover.
$comment_p2: The V2 gate ignores model findings, summary, memory/KG and spawned candidates. It requires a non-empty exact DB snapshot set; zero approved is valid only when every frozen work item is an evidence-backed no-candidate decision.
$comment_gate_rules: candidate_disposition_complete is persisted-contract aware: V2 consumes VerificationTruthSnapshot only; legacy retains deliverable compatibility.

on_fail.reason: exact Verification DB truth is missing or an ever-approved Candidate lacks a valid terminal Attempt
hints: run only the scheduler-bound candidate_verifier and submit_candidate_attempt
verified requires exact proof evidence plus Finding lineage; refuted requires refutation evidence; blocked requires blocker evidence or a stable reason code
